scenes.say: Verstappen could lock up second place in Qatar. What does he need?
Verstappen has three hundred four. Hamilton is thirty-seven back, Russell and Norris forty.
No sprints left, no fastest lap point. Twenty-five per race, tops.
Leclerc is fifty-four back and out of reach. It's a three-way fight.
With a podium in Qatar, second is his whatever the others do.
Fourth place is enough, as long as Hamilton doesn't win the race.
Even zero points is enough, if none of the three reaches the podium.
If points are tied, more wins decide it. Verstappen has four.

title: Verstappen could seal second place in Qatar: here is what he needs
